title: 基于内容哈希的批量原子编辑
acceptance_tests: SHA-256 uses UTF-8 and lowercase hex
single edit preserves inputs and untouched files
same-file edits use the original snapshot despite replacement length and new target text
cross-file stale conflict leaves every original file unchanged
missing files and inherited properties are not editable
missing, duplicate, and overlapping occurrences are rejected
adjacent Unicode regions and literal replacement special characters work
empty batch returns a new mapping including special own keys
malformed input is rejected without mutation
